subject: math
topicName: College Review Week 3: Algebra Translation and Modeling
description: Train the student to turn words into variables, equations, and constraints instead of guessing from answer choices.
learningObjectives: Define variables clearly before manipulating expressions
Translate common word-problem patterns into equations and inequalities
Solve age, consecutive integer, and number relationship problems systematically
Use substitution and checking to verify that a modeled answer actually fits the prompt
